description: Every import declaration must carry the country goods were shipped FROM. CDS rejects with CDS10001/CDS12100 22B 090 when ExportCountry.ID is blank or set to GB on a non-UK lane.

description: Brazil currently has no preferential agreement with the UK. Declaring U110 (or any U-series preference doc) on a BR lane will be rejected as inappropriate.

description: When the declaration is in minimal mode (default for new lanes) the engine refuses every document, regardless of code. The user must promote the lane to enriched mode before adding docs — that way bad data can't slip in by default.

predicates.name: WILDCARD_FORBID_ALL_DOCUMENTS

name: Minimal mode forbids any AdditionalDocument

description: When the user has set declaration.invoiceTotal explicitly, the sum of goods_items.valueAmount must match within 0.01. Catches data entry drift before CDS does.
name: Sum of item values must match declaration invoiceTotal
source: Empirical — CDS routinely rejects invoice/item value mismatches
